(def ^number max
"Returns the greatest of the nums."
(fn ([x] x)
  ([x y] (suss.bootstrap/max x y))
  ([x y & more]
   (reduce max (suss.bootstrap/max x y) more))))
rationale: Retain the pinned declaration metadata, documentation and signatures, with original scalar lowering following JVM Clojure 1.12.6 core.clj and Numbers.java (EPL 1.0, https://github.com/clojure/clojure/tree/clojure-1.12.6). Boxed Object overloads propagate NaN before checking the other operand, preserve the chosen argument type and select the second value on ties; primitive double/double source calls separately use IEEE signed-zero min/max. No upstream Java code is copied or shipped. Public compatibility remains in progress; executed inline/boxed, primitive return and evaluation-order evidence is in results/m12-extrema and clojure_numeric_extrema.rs.
